name: ShieldAgent-Bench
description: ShieldAgent-Bench is a dataset of 3,000 safety-related pairs of agent instructions and action trajectories, collected via state-of-the-art attacks across 6 web environments and 7 risk categories, designed to evaluate guardrail agents enforcing safety policy compliance in autonomous agents.
reputation: A recent safety benchmark for autonomous agents that is still emerging, with adoption mainly among agent-safety and guardrail research groups.
notes: First guardrail benchmark for agents; includes diverse risk categories and environments; used to evaluate ShieldAgent.
